desc: The LWRCI IC-A5 (Individual Carbine MkII) is a high-performance, short-stroke gas piston rifle designed for durability, reliability, and superior handling. Built on a fully ambidextrous lower receiver, it features a cold-hammer-forged spiral-fluted barrel for enhanced heat dissipation and reduced weight. The rifle comes equipped with a Monoforge upper, a free-floating handguard with modular rail sections, and an adjustable gas block for suppressed or unsuppressed use. Designed for tactical professionals and enthusiasts alike, the IC-A5 delivers precision, ruggedness, and next-level ergonomics in a modern AR platform.
